description: Principal identity record. Carries the DID, display + full name, key metadata, and rotation history for the principal who owns this vault. Lives on disk as `<self_root>/identity.md` — YAML frontmatter (machine-enforced fields) + markdown body (principal-editable prose). Same on-disk pattern as `tech.equanimi.secretariat.channelDef` and `tech.equanimi.secretariat.contract`. The active signing key referenced by `key_path` lives as raw PKCS#8 bytes at the relative path the field names (conventionally `identity/key`); rotated keys archive to `identity/key.<rotation-ts>` and append an entry to `key_rotations`. This record is private to the principal's device — never sent on wire.

did.description: The principal's canonical decentralized identifier — `did:web:<host>` for domain-anchored principals, `did:key:z<multibase>` for self-contained identities.

did_method.description: DID method, redundant with the DID itself but useful for tooling that wants to branch without reparsing. MUST match the actual method of `did`.

display_name.description: Informal name for UI surfaces — `Rafa`, `Marcelo`. Validates against the `DisplayName` value object (non-empty, length-bounded, no control characters).

full_name.description: Optional formal name for envelope signatures and legal artifacts — `Rafael T. Ballestiero`. Defaults to `display_name` when absent.

key_path.description: Path to the active signing key, relative to `identity.md`. Conventionally `identity/key`. The file is raw PKCS#8 bytes (mode `0600`); never base64-encoded or wrapped here.

key_type.description: Cryptographic algorithm of the key referenced by `key_path`. Only `ed25519` today; expanded when key-type negotiation lands.

key_created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the active key was generated.

key_rotations.description: Append-only log of past key rotations. Each entry: `{archived_path, rotated_at, reason?}`. Active key always lives at `key_path`; rotated keys move to `identity/key.<ts>` and gain an entry here. Empty array for fresh installs; never deleted entries (auditability).

archived_path.description: Relative path to the archived key file (e.g. `identity/key.2026-09-12T14-30-00Z`).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this identity record was first written. May predate the active `key_created_at` if a rotation has occurred.
